primary_sources.finding: Shortening depends on the sound before restored 하. ㄼ has lexical exceptions. The explanation distinguishes predicate-stem suffix boundaries from other boundaries before ㅎ. ㄶ/ㅀ rules about following plain stops do not themselves specify the sequence before 하.
primary_sources.scope: Do not transfer 히 suffix pronunciation or the shortened ending onset to hypothetical 하다 roots.

primary_sources.finding: Explicitly separates final ㅎ plus a following plain stop from a preceding plain stop plus following ㅎ; the suffix/context distinction applies to the latter.
Article 40 uses the preceding consonant sound to distinguish full 하 loss from aspiration; it does not provide examples for the three pending complex codas.

native_scan.selection: Every native predicate/auxiliary head ending in 하다 with a nonempty base and final precomposed Hangul syllable; independent of current recovery.
native_scan.limitation: Zero entries in this pinned dictionary is not a grammatical impossibility judgment or a complete lexicon search.
